Source: @bamotamem

I usually record my exercises under the lessons themselves, like the other Motamem members, and I also talk with other Motamem members under those same lessons in the form of comments and replies to comments. But this time I wanted to explain something, and I saw that it got very long and really wasn't suitable for a comment. So I published it as a post in the Rooznevesht section. Because it's very important to me, I'm putting it here so that if you'd like (and have the patience), you can read it: What is the purpose of Motamem? (What function does Motamem serve?)
